senses.gloss:
Dhavala(sāndhivigrahin)
ins. poet. wrote the Narasapatam Plates of Vajrahasta III. 1045 A. D.
Epi. Ind. XI. p. 147-53.

Dhavala
authority on dh. Q. by Allāḍanātha in Nirṇayāmṛta, Lz. 500; by Ādityabhaṭṭa in Kālādarśa, IO. 5597. MD. 3115; by Jīmūtavāhana in Kālaviveka (7 times); by Raghunandana in Tithitattva (Serampore edn. I. 36).
See JASB. XI (1915) 315. 367.
Earlier than 1050 A. D. See Kane, HDS. I. p. 705b.
C.. Dhavalanibandha an. ºsmṛti below.

Dhavala
Jain. son of Sūra, a Brahmin; pupil of Ambasena Ṛṣi.
--Harivam3śapurāṇa in Apabhram3śa. in 122 sandhis. CPB. 8179. Delhi III. 285.
Mentioned by Puṣpadanta in his Mahāpurāṇa (965 A. D.). See Allahabad Uni. Studies I. (1925) 165. See also Jaina Sid. Bhās. XX. ii. p. 25. fn. 3. [Page283-a.

Dhavalacandra
teacher of Gajasāra (a. of Caturvim3śatidaṇḍaka or Ṣaṭtrim3śikāvicāra, IO. 7551. See NCC. VI. p. 327a).

Dhavalacandra
patron of Nārāyaṇa (a. of Hitopadeśa).

Dhavaladhṛtasmṛti
Q. by Bhavadeva Nyāyālaṅkāra in Smṛticandra, IO. 1482.
C.. next an. Dhavalasmṛti below.

Dhavalanibandha
ref. to by Kāśīnātha in his Caṇḍikārcanadīpikā, RASB. VIII. A. 6405; by Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa in Aurdhvedehikapaddhati, IO. 480 (Antyeṣṭiº) an. Kamalākara in Nirṇayasindhu.
C.. Dhavala an. Dhavalasmṛti.

Dhavalapurāṇa
Jain. Oudh 1875, 50. XI. 36.
See also Mahādhavalapurāṇa, Oudh 1875, 50 an. Vijayadhavalapurāṇa, ibid.

Dhavalasaṅgraha
dh. text from Assam. Q. by Krṣṇamiśra in Kālasarvasva; by Jīmūtavāhana in Kālaviveka; by Gadādhara in Kālasāra; by Viśvanātha in his Smṛtisārasaṅgraha, RASB. III. 2676. prob. same a. Dhavalanibandha.
See Kane, HDS. I. p. 570b. J. of Assam Res. Soc. XIV. 1960. p. 93. Orissa His.. Res. J. VI. i. p. 63.

Dhavalasmṛti
Rice 204.
Q. by Raghunandana in Tithitattva.
See also Dhavala above.
